大嘴狗
[德] 安娜·玛尔 / 文
[德] 本特·穆克·塔塞尔 / 图
陈 宝 / 译
因为嘴太大，别人都不愿意收留大嘴狗，看到他的人也都被吓跑了。
小男孩卢卡斯是那么想拥有一个自己的马戏团，可是因为太小，他没办法建立自己的马戏团。
当饥饿的大嘴狗遇到一心想建立马戏团的卢卡斯时，一个很棒的马戏团成立了。
从此，能干的大嘴狗就和卢卡斯一家快乐地生活在一起。
page_text_en:
Big-Mouth Dog
[Germany] Anna Märt / Text
[Germany] Bent Mücke-Tassler / Illustrations
Chen Bao / Translator
Because his mouth is too big, no one wants to take in Big-Mouth Dog, and people who see him run away scared.
The little boy Lucas dreams of having his own circus, but because he is too young, he can't start one on his own.
When the hungry Big-Mouth Dog meets Lucas, who dreams of starting a circus, a wonderful circus is formed.
From then on, the capable Big-Mouth Dog lives happily with Lucas and his family.
summary_zh: 本页为绘本《大嘴狗》的封面及内容简介，介绍了大嘴狗因嘴大被嫌弃，小男孩卢卡斯想建马戏团却因年幼无法实现，两人相遇后共同组建了马戏团并快乐生活在一起的故事梗概。

page_text_ocr_zh:
这就是伯尔——一只黄颜色的大狗。伯尔对周围的人极有礼貌，穿衣服也很得体，可就是没有人愿意收留他。
可怜的伯尔，一直没有自己的家，因为人人都害怕他那张像鳄鱼一样大的嘴巴。
只要有机会，伯尔就会向人们介绍自己：
“您好，我是伯尔，我想请求您带我回家……”可是，还没等他说完，听的人就吓得大叫着逃跑了。谁也不愿意听完他的话。
其实，伯尔是一只十分有教养的狗，他会洗餐具，还会在睡觉前抖干净要铺的毯子呢。
起初，伯尔还以为人们是害怕他那低沉的声音呢，于是……
您好！
page_text_en:
This is Ber — a big yellow dog. Ber is very polite to people around him and dresses very neatly, but no one is willing to take him in.
Poor Ber has never had his own home, because everyone is afraid of his mouth, which is as big as a crocodile's.
Whenever he gets a chance, Ber introduces himself to people:
"Hello, I'm Ber. I'd like to ask you to take me home..." But before he can finish, the people listening scream and run away. No one wants to hear him finish.
In fact, Ber is a very well-mannered dog. He can wash dishes and even fluff up his blanket before going to sleep.
At first, Ber thought people were afraid of his deep voice. So...
Hello!
summary_zh: 本页介绍了主角大嘴狗伯尔，它虽然礼貌得体、有教养，但因嘴巴太大而无人收留，它试图向人们介绍自己却总被吓跑，起初以为是人们害怕它低沉的声音。

page_text_ocr_zh:

当然，他的大嘴巴也就显得更大了。

后来，伯尔又试着在说话时
不把嘴巴张得那么大。他只用嗡嗡的鼻音说：
“你（您）好，我是（素）伯尔……”
那声音听起来就像可怕的呼噜声，
人们还是吓得转身就跑。

卢卡斯是一个个头特别小的小男孩。
他妈妈，在收拾房间时，一不留神，就会把他和布娃娃、
动物玩偶们混在一起。当然啦，这样的
事情毕竟不是经常发生的。
page_text_en:
Later, Berl tried speaking without opening his mouth so wide. He used a buzzing nasal voice: 
"Hello (or 'Good day'), I'm (Soo) Berl..." 
That sound was like a scary snore, 
and people still turned and ran in fright.

Lukas was a very small boy.
His mom, when tidying the room, would sometimes accidentally mix him in with his dolls and animal toys. Of course, such things don't happen often.
summary_zh: 本页描述了大嘴狗伯尔尝试用小声说话但仍吓跑人们，以及小男孩卢卡斯因个头小常被妈妈误当成玩具的情节。

page_text_ocr_zh:
不过，小卢卡斯一点儿也不在乎这些。

page_text_en:
However, little Lucas didn't care about any of that.
He had his own dream — to become a circus animal trainer.
Little Lucas also wanted to have his own circus!
summary_zh: 本页描绘了小男孩卢卡斯在马戏团场景中的梦想，他想成为一名驯兽师，并拥有自己的马戏团，表现出他对未来的憧憬和积极态度。

page_text_ocr_zh:
瞧，他的小豚鼠丽萨和佛里茨
已经学会抛小球了。
青蛙劳拉呢，每天都在练习吹小号。
不过，小卢卡斯的妈妈可受不了啦！她好讨厌劳拉那总是跑调的小号声，更讨厌小豚鼠那到处乱抛、常常让人跌倒的小球。
最后，小卢卡斯只好让他的小动物们从家里搬了出去。
他在院子里给他们重新搭了一间小木屋。
page_text_en:
Look, his little guinea pigs Lisa and Fritz
have already learned to throw little balls.
The frog Laura, meanwhile, practices playing the trumpet every day.
But little Lucas's mom can't stand it! She hates Laura's off-key trumpet sounds even more than she hates the guinea pigs' balls, which are always thrown around and often trip people up.
In the end, little Lucas had to move his little animals out of the house.
He built them a new little wooden house in the yard.
summary_zh: 小男孩卢卡斯的小动物们在家中制造混乱，妈妈无法忍受，于是卢卡斯将它们搬到院子里，并为它们搭建了一间新的小木屋。

One evening, Lucas was preparing to give his little animals a training session. There, he met Berl for the first time. Berl was putting scattered trash around the garbage can back in, and he also picked out some edible items.
When he saw Berl, Lucas jumped in surprise.
You see, Berl was much taller than him.
Still, he gathered his courage and carefully looked at Berl.
Berl worried his appearance might scare the little boy and wanted to leave quickly. But unexpectedly, the boy shouted at him: "Please sit down!"
Berl looked at Lucas in surprise and obediently sat down.

summary_zh: 小男孩卢卡斯在准备给小动物们上训练课时，第一次遇见了在垃圾桶旁捡拾物品的大嘴狗伯尔。尽管伯尔因体型巨大而让卢卡斯吓了一跳，但卢卡斯鼓起勇气，主动邀请伯尔坐下，伯尔因此感到惊讶并乖乖坐下，两人初次相遇。

page_text_ocr_zh:
“不要害怕，我觉得你是一只很可爱的大狗。” 小卢卡斯说着，

page_text_en:
"Don't be afraid, I think you're a very lovely big dog," said Little Lucas, 
and he kindly extended his hand to stroke Berl. Berl also kindly 
opened his big mouth and smiled, and Little Lucas quickly pulled his hand back.

"Hello, I'm..." Berl whispered. But he noticed Lucas hadn't heard him at all, 
so he immediately opened his big mouth: "...I'm Berl, I really hope you can take me home."
"Oh! This... probably not! My mom doesn't like keeping animals at home. But... if you're willing, 
I can train you to join my circus," said Little Lucas.

"I want to tell you, I can wash dishes, and I can also shake my own blanket clean..." Berl hurriedly said.

"No, no, that's too ordinary," Little Lucas shook his head, "I need some special skills.
Hmm, let me think, is there a better idea...?"
summary_zh: 小卢卡斯主动向大嘴狗伯尔示好，伯尔因声音太大而张开大嘴说话，吓到卢卡斯。卢卡斯提出可以训练伯尔加入自己的马戏团，伯尔急忙展示自己会洗餐具和整理毯子，但卢卡斯认为这些本领太普通，需要更特别的技能。

很快，小卢卡斯就有了一个好主意。
他和伯尔一起训练了几天之后，
就带着他的动物们举办首场对外演出了。

观众们微笑着欣赏了小豚鼠的抛球表演，
也欣赏了劳拉吹小号。当然，他们最想看到的是
下一个节目——猛兽表演。

嘹亮的铜号声响起来，小卢卡斯上场了。
为了能够看得更清楚一些，不少观众
还站了起来。随着小卢卡斯的指挥，大狗伯尔闪亮登场了。
page_text_en:
Soon, Lucas had a great idea.
After training with Berl for a few days,
he held his first outdoor show with his animals.

The audience smiled as they watched the guinea pigs' ball-throwing performance,
and also enjoyed Laura playing the trumpet. Of course, they were most eager to see
the next act—the wild animal show.

A bright trumpet call rang out, and Lucas took the stage.
To get a better view, many audience members stood up. Under Lucas's direction, the big dog Berl made his dazzling entrance.
summary_zh: 小卢卡斯和大嘴狗伯尔经过几天训练后，举办了一场户外动物表演。观众们欣赏了小豚鼠和劳拉的表演，最后期待已久的猛兽表演中，小卢卡斯指挥大狗伯尔闪亮登场。

观众们大叫起来。小卢卡斯不慌不忙地走到大嘴狗面前，大声喊道：“伯尔！”伯尔立刻张开了他的大嘴巴。观众们顿时变得鸦雀无声了，只听见小豚鼠把球抛到地上的滚动声。

看，小卢卡斯把头伸进了伯尔的大嘴里！

“我的天哪！”坐在第一排的几个观众，竟然被这情景吓得晕倒了。

当小卢卡斯把头从伯尔的大嘴中移出来时，观众们兴奋地鼓起掌来：“耶！太精彩了！”掌声持续了好长好长时间……
page_text_en:
The audience shouted. Little Lucas calmly walked up to the big-mouthed dog and shouted, "Bor!" Bor immediately opened his big mouth. The audience instantly fell silent, only hearing the squeaky sound of the little guinea pig rolling the ball on the ground.

Look, Little Lucas put his head into Bor's big mouth!

"Oh my gosh!" A few audience members sitting in the front row were actually frightened to the point of fainting.

When Little Lucas pulled his head out of Bor's big mouth, the audience excitedly clapped: "Yeah! Amazing!" The applause lasted for a long, long time...
summary_zh: 在户外动物表演的高潮部分，小卢卡斯勇敢地将头伸进大嘴狗伯尔的口中，观众们先是惊呆，随后为这惊险又精彩的表演热烈鼓掌。

page_text_en: Mom thought Berl was very cute. When she discovered that Berl could also wash dishes, shake out his own rug, use a vacuum cleaner to clean, and iron clothes, she agreed to Lucas's request and kept Berl.
